subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellDriver1/Drivers: Fix memory leaks
reasons: Adds SHELL_FREE_NON_NULL() calls before early-return paths in a single file; fixes two specific missing free sites
Memory leak fixes of this kind require case-by-case analysis of which variables are allocated and which early-return paths are missing the free
The sibling commit cfcb4eee91 adds ShellCommandLineFreeVarList() in a similar pattern, but the specific resources differ per site
